blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet adapting them to new tasks and domains remains inefficient: existing methods often rely on parameter tuning, incurring substantial costs and risking catastrophic forgetting of previously learned tasks. To address this, we propose Optimus-R , a memory-centric VLA framework that formulates robotic adaptation as explicit query-skill memory tuning. Optimus-R introduces: (i) An Inline Memory Interface for skill extraction . It inserts learnable memory tokens into the VLA prefix stream, allowing the backbone to derive control-aware query and skill representations within the native action-conditioning pathway. (ii) A Query-Skill Memory Bank for skill learning . It externalizes skills into query prototypes for deciding what to retrieve and skill values for specifying how to act, supporting skill reuse and expansion with limited parameter updates. (iii) A lightweight Bridge-and-Adapt mechanism for skill updating . It aligns target-domain queries and skills with the existing memory space through a lightweight adapter and residual memory updates. Experiments on in-domain adaptation, cross-domain adaptation, and lifelong learning show that Optimus-R enables data-efficient skill learning while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
blocks.zh: 远景-语言-行动模型显示出对通用机器人操纵的强烈希望,但使其适应新的任务和领域仍然效率不高:现有方法往往依赖参数调整,费用高昂,并有可能灾难性地忘记以前学到的任务。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出Optimus-R,一个以记忆为中心的VLA框架,这个框架将机器人适应作为明确的查询技能记忆调谐. Optimus-R介绍: (一)用于技能提取的内置内存接口. 它将可学习的内存符号插入VLA前缀流,使骨干在本土的动作调节路径中可以得出控制意识的查询和技能表现. (二) 技能学习查询-技能记忆库。 它将技能外化为用于决定检索什么的查询原型,并将技能值用于具体说明如何行动,支持技能再利用和有限参数更新的扩展. (三) 技术更新的轻量级桥梁和适应机制。 它通过轻量级适配器和剩余内存更新,将目标域查询和技能与现有的内存空间相协调. 关于域内适应、跨域适应和终生学习的实验表明,Optimus-R能够提高数据效率,同时减轻灾难性的遗忘。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison between parameter-centric adaptation and our memory-centric adaptation framework.
blocks.zh: 图1:以参数为中心的适应与我们以记忆为中心的适应框架的比较。

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models ( Black et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) have become a promising foundation for general-purpose robotic manipulation ( Chi et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2022 ) , benefiting from large-scale pretraining on diverse robotic datasets ( Liu et al., 2023a ; Khazatsky et al., 2024 ; Mees et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . However, deployment in the real world ( Zitkovich et al., 2023 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Intelligence et al., 2025a ) requires robots to adapt to new tasks, objects, scenes, and domains with limited demonstrations. Most current VLAs perform such adaptation by updating model parameters ( Hu et al., 2021 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . While effective, this parameter-centric paradigm makes every new skill an implicit change to the model weights, leading to high adaptation cost and possible interference with previously learned tasks. This motivates a crucial question: can a VLA acquire, store, and reuse skills through an explicit memory interface, rather than repeatedly updating its model parameters?
blocks.zh: Vision-Langage-Action(VLA)模型(Black等人,2024年;Kim等人,2024年) 2024; Kim等人, 2025; Zhang等人, 2025; Shi等人, 2025; )已经成为通用机器人操纵的有希望的基础(Chi等人, 2025; Jiang等人, 2022),受益于关于多种机器人数据集的大规模预训(Liu等人, 2023a; Khazatsky等人, 2024; Mees等人, 2022; Chen等人, 2025)。 然而,在现实世界的部署(Zitkovich等人,2023年;Bjorck等人,2025年;Intelligence等人,2025年a)需要机器人适应新的任务,物体,场景,以及演示有限的领域. 目前大多数VLA通过更新模型参数进行这种适应(Hu等人,2021年;Kim等人,2025年;Wen等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年b). 这个以参数为中心的范式虽然有效,但使每种新技能都成为模型权重的隐含变化,导致适应成本高,并可能干扰先前学到的任务. 这引发了一个关键问题:VLA能否通过明确的内存接口,而不是反复更新其模型参数,获得,存储和再利用技能?

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 1 , a memory-centric VLA must address three coupled issues. First, skills should be derived from the VLA model itself rather than attached as detached context: external retrieval memories are only weakly coupled with the VLA action-conditioning pathway, which limits their ability to encode control-relevant information ( Li et al., 2026 ; Temiraliev et al., 2026 ) . Second, skills should be organized explicitly rather than absorbed into model weights: parameter updates make newly acquired behaviors hard to retrieve, expand, or reuse, and may interfere with previous skills during continual learning ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . Third, skills should remain retrievable under domain shift: visual or dynamics changes can move target-domain observations away from the source-domain memory space, causing mismatches between queries and stored skills ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . These issues motivate a unified view of adaptation as skill extraction, skill learning, and skill updating.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,以记忆为中心的VLA必须解决三个连带问题。 首先,技能应来自VLA模型本身,而不是作为脱节上下文附着:外部检索记忆仅与VLA动作调节路径微弱结合,限制了他们编码控制相关信息的能力(Li等人,2026年;Temiraliev等人,2026年)。 第二,技能应明确组织,而不是吸收到模型权重中:参数更新使得新获得的行为难以检索,扩展,或再利用,在持续学习期间可能干扰以前的技能(Wang等人,2026a). 第三,在域位移下,技能应该保持可检索性:视觉或动态变化可以将目标域观测移离源域内存空间,导致查询和存储技能不匹配(徐等人,2026年). 这些问题促使人们将适应视为技能的提取、技能学习和技能更新。

blocks.en: To this end, we propose Optimus-R , a memory-centric framework for VLA adaptation. Optimus-R introduces : (i) Inline Memory Interface for skill extraction. It inserts learnable memory tokens into the VLA prefix stream, allowing the backbone to derive control-aware query and skill representations within the native policy pathway. (ii) Query-Skill Memory Bank for skill learning. It externalizes skills into query prototypes for deciding what to retrieve and skill values for specifying how to act, enabling new tasks to be learned by reusing, updating, or appending memory entries rather than repeatedly tuning model parameters. (iii) Bridge-and-Adapt mechanism for skill updating. It aligns target-domain queries and skill values to the existing memory space through lightweight adapter and residual memory updates, improving skill retrieval under domain shift.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提出Optimus-R,一个以记忆为中心的VLA适应框架. Optimus-R引入: (一)内置内存接口用于技能提取. 它在VLA前缀流中插入可学习的内存符号,使骨干能够在本土政策路径中得出具有控制意识的查询和技能表示. (二)腾讯-技能记忆库开展技能学习. 它将技能外部化为决定检索什么的查询原型,以及指定如何行动的技能值,通过重用、更新或附加内存条目,而不是反复调试模型参数来学习新的任务。 (三) 技能更新的桥梁与适应机制。 它通过轻量级适配器和剩余内存更新,将目标域查询和技能值与现有内存空间相协调,在域转移下改进技能检索.

blocks.en: We conduct experiments on in-domain adaptation, cross-domain adaptation, and in-domain lifelong learning. On LIBERO, CALVIN, and RoboTwin 2.0, Optimus-R consistently improves over the strong π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Intelligence et al., 2025b ) baseline under low-data regimes: with only 30% training data, it improves the LIBERO average success rate by 16.5%, the CALVIN average completion length by 0.42, and the RoboTwin 2.0 Hard success rate by 5.0%. For cross-domain transfer, Optimus-R achieves a 33.3% real-world success rate with only 20 demonstrations per task, outperforming π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} by 13.9%. In lifelong learning, Optimus-R improves 20-demo new-task success by 11.0% over π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and reduces average forgetting from 15.0% to 10.0% after 80-demo adaptation.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose Optimus-R , a memory-centric VLA framework that treats robotic adaptation as explicit query-skill memory tuning, reducing the need for repeated model weight updates during continual learning. • We introduce an Inline Memory Interface that inserts learnable memory tokens into the VLA prefix stream, enabling the backbone to produce control-aware query and skill representations within the policy’s native action-conditioning pathway. • We design a Query-Skill Memory Bank that externalizes skills as decoupled query prototypes and skill values. This bank-centered design supports skill reuse, skill expansion, and continual task adaptation with limited parameter updates. • We develop a Bridge-and-Adapt strategy that performs lightweight memory-space alignment for cross-domain transfer, improving the retrievability of source-domain skills under target-domain shifts such as sim-to-real adaptation.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action models ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Pertsch et al., 2025 ; Qu et al., 2025 ; Bu et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025b ; Song et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2023b ; Liu et al., 2025 ) are a central paradigm for robotic manipulation, spanning early multimodal policies and large generalist robot models pretrained on diverse datasets ( Liu et al., 2023a ; Mees et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Zitkovich et al., 2023 ; Intelligence et al., 2025b ) . Recent work improves VLA policies through continuous action modeling ( Li et al., 2024a ; Kim et al., 2025 ) , diffusion or flow-based generation ( Intelligence et al., 2025b ; Chi et al., 2025 ) , action tokenization ( Pertsch et al., 2025 ) , and efficient adaptation ( Wen et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . However, most downstream adaptation remains parameter-centric, learning new skills through model fine-tuning. Optimus-R keeps the pretrained VLA largely reusable, adapting through an explicit query-skill memory interface.
blocks.zh: 远景-语言行动模型(Zhang等人,2025年;Kim等人,2024年;Pertsch等人,2025年;Qu等人,2025年;Bu等人,2025年;Song等人,2025年b;Song等人,2025年a;Li等人,2025年b;Li等人,2023年b;Liu等人,2025年b)是机器人操纵的核心范例,跨越早期的多模式政策和在各种数据集上预先培训的大型通用机器人模型(Liu等人,2023年a; Mees等人,2022年;Chen等人,2025年;Zitkovich等人,2023年;Intelligence等人,2025年b。 最近的工作通过持续的行动模式改进了志愿军政策(Li等人,2024a); Kim等人,2025年),传播或流源生成(Intelligence等人,2025年b;Chi等人,2025年b),动作标志化(Pertsch等人,2025年),高效适应(Wen等人,2025年b). 然而,大多数下游适应仍然是以参数为中心,通过模型微调学习新的技能。 Optimus-R保留了预先训练的VLA基本可重复使用,通过一个明确的查询技能内存接口进行改造.

blocks.en: Memory mechanisms extend context and support decision making in embodied agents ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025c ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024b ) . In robotics, recent memory-augmented methods store demonstrations, experiences, scene histories, or external knowledge to improve long-horizon planning and manipulation ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . These methods regard memory as external context or episodic retrieval. In contrast, Optimus-R injects memory into the VLA prefix stream and maintains a persistent query-skill bank for efficient adaptation.
blocks.zh: 记忆机制扩展了内涵物剂的背景和支持决策(张等,2024;贺等,2024;宋等,2024;李等,2025c;朱等,2024;谢等,2024;李等,2024b). 在机器人学方面,最近的记忆增强方法存储了演示、经验、场景历史或外部知识,以改善长视野的规划和操纵(Shi等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年a); Lin等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年). 这些方法将内存视为外部上下文或偶发检索. 相比之下,Optimus-R将内存注入VLA前缀流,并维持一个持续的查询技能库,以高效适应.

blocks.en: Foundation models adapt via in-context learning ( Brown et al., 2020 ) , prompt tuning ( Lester et al., 2021 ) , LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) , adapters ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , or frozen-backbone transfer ( Li et al., 2023a ; Dai et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023b ; Karamcheti et al., 2024 ) . Existing VLAs improve data efficiency but still encode new skills in model parameters ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . Optimus-R instead externalizes skills into a global memory bank, updating only lightweight alignment modules, prototype residuals, and bank entries.
blocks.zh: 基础模型通过内文学习来适应(Brown等人,2020年),即时调谐. (Lester等人,2021年),LORA(Hu等人,2021年),适配器(Zhang等人,2023年),或冷冻背骨转移. (Li等人,2023a); Dai等人,2023年;Liu等人,2023年b;Karamcheti等人,2024年). 现有 VLA提高了数据效率,但仍编码模型参数的新技能(Kim等人,2025年;Wen等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年b). Optimus-R转而将技能外部化成一个全球内存库,仅更新轻量级对齐模块,原型残基,以及银行条目.

A dual-head memory readout derives a query embedding q t q_{t} for retrieval and a skill embedding s t s_{t} for behavior representation, with s t s_{t} supervised by a skill decoder during training. The retrieved skill is projected into VLA-compatible skill tokens and used to condition the flow policy for action-chunk generation.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We present Optimus-R , a memory-centric adaptation framework for vision-language-action (VLA) models. It combines an Inline Memory Interface for extracting query and skill representations, a Query-Skill Memory Bank for storing reusable skills, and Bridge-and-Adapt training for adapting retrieval and policy conditioning from limited demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Optimus-R,这是一个以记忆为中心的视觉语言行动模型适应框架。 它结合了用于提取查询和技能表达的内在记忆接口、用于存储可重复使用技能的查询-技能记忆库和用于调整有限的演示的检索和政策条件的Bridge-and-Adapt培训。

blocks.en: Table 1 shows consistent gains over π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Intelligence et al., 2025b ) across all three benchmarks and data regimes. With 30% training data, Optimus-R improves LIBERO average success by 16.5 percentage points, with a particularly large gain on LIBERO-Long. This suggests that reusable skill prototypes benefit long-horizon tasks with temporally structured behaviors. With full data, Optimus-R achieves the best LIBERO average and RoboTwin 2.0 Hard performance among the compared methods, while remaining competitive on CALVIN. These results support our design goal: using target-domain demonstrations to refine and reuse externalized skill memory rather than relearning the policy through repeated global parameter updates.

blocks.en: We transfer a RoboTwin 2.0-pretrained model to nine real-world tasks with 20, 50, and 80 demonstrations per task, reporting average success over 20 rollouts per task. The platform is a 14-DoF bimanual GALAXEA R1 Lite robot with wrist-mounted and third-person cameras at 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented Optimus-R , a memory-centric VLA framework that formulates robotic adaptation as explicit query-skill memory tuning. Optimus-R introduces three key designs: an Inline Memory Interface for deriving control-aware query and skill representations within the native VLA policy pathway, a Query-Skill Memory Bank for externalizing skills into reusable and expandable memory entries, and a lightweight Bridge-and-Adapt mechanism for aligning target-domain queries and skills with the existing memory space. Experiments across in-domain adaptation, cross-domain adaptation, and lifelong learning show that Optimus-R enables data-efficient adaptation, improves skill reuse, and reduces reliance on conventional fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Optimus-R,一个以记忆为中心的VLA框架,它将机器人适应作为明确的查询技能记忆调谐. Optimus-R引入了三种关键设计:用于在原生VLA政策路径内产生控制-意识查询和技能表示的内置内存接口;用于将技能外部化为可重复使用和可扩展的内存条目的查询-技能记忆库;以及用于将目标领域查询和技能与现有内存空间相匹配的轻量级桥-适配机制。 跨越域内适应,跨域适应,终身学习的实验显示,Optimus-R可以实现数据高效的适应,提高技能再利用,减少对常规微调的依赖.

blocks.en: Appendix A Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: 附录A 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Optimus-R aims to improve the data efficiency and reusability of Vision-Language-Action models by shifting robotic adaptation from repeated parameter updates to explicit query-skill memory tuning. This design may reduce the amount of task-specific data and computation required to adapt robots to new environments, thereby lowering the cost of deploying robotic systems. The memory-centric formulation also provides a more explicit interface for inspecting, reusing, and updating learned skills, which may support more maintainable lifelong robotic systems.
blocks.zh: Optimus-R旨在通过将机器人适应从重复参数更新转向明确的查询技能内存调试,提高Vision-Language-Action模型的数据效率和可重复性. 这种设计可能减少使机器人适应新环境所需的特定任务数据和计算量,从而降低部署机器人系统的成本. 以记忆为中心的配制也为检查,重用和更新学习技能提供了更加明确的界面,这可以支持更可维护的终身机器人系统.

blocks.en: At the same time, improved adaptation efficiency can also increase the risk of deploying robots in insufficiently validated environments. Retrieved or reused skills may behave unexpectedly under unseen objects, unsafe scene configurations, or distribution shifts beyond those covered during adaptation. Moreover, real-world robotic data may contain sensitive visual information, and memory banks or stored exemplars should be managed with appropriate privacy and data-governance safeguards.
blocks.zh: 同时,提高适应效率也会增加在未经充分验证的环境中部署机器人的风险. 获取或再利用的技能可能出乎意料地表现在隐形物体、不安全的场景配置或分配转移中超出适应时覆盖的范围。 此外,现实世界的机器人数据可能包含敏感的视觉信息,记忆库或存储的示例应当有适当的隐私和数据治理保障。

blocks.en: Appendix B Limitation
blocks.zh: 附录B 限制

blocks.en: Despite its effectiveness, Optimus-R has several limitations. First, the framework relies on a strong pretrained VLA backbone; when the base policy lacks the necessary manipulation primitives, memory retrieval and prototype expansion alone may be insufficient. Second, although the Query-Skill Memory Bank improves skill reuse, its quality depends on the coverage and clustering of the pretraining and adaptation data. Poorly organized or sparse memory entries may lead to suboptimal retrieval, especially for tasks with fine-grained temporal or contact-rich behaviors. Third, cross-domain transfer still requires a small amount of target-domain demonstrations and careful memory-space alignment. The lightweight Bridge-and-Adapt mechanism mitigates representational drift, but it does not guarantee reliable transfer under large embodiment changes, severe visual shifts, or substantially different dynamics.
blocks.zh: 尽管其有效性,Optimus-R有多个局限性. 首先,框架依赖于一个经过预先训练的强大的VLA主干线;当基础政策缺乏必要的操纵原始时,仅内存检索和原型扩展可能是不够的. 第二,虽然Query-Skill记忆库提高技能再利用,但其质量取决于预训和适应数据的覆盖范围和分组。 组织不良或记忆条目稀少可能导致不理想的检索,特别是对于有精细的时间或接触丰富的行为的任务. 第三,跨域传输仍然需要少量的目标域演示和仔细的内存空间对齐. 轻量级的桥-和-适配机制减轻了表征漂移,但并不能保证在大浮雕变化,严重视觉转变,或显著不同的动态下可靠转移.

blocks.en: Appendix E Evaluation on RoboTwin 2.0

blocks.en: RoboTwin 2.0 provides a standardized benchmark for bimanual manipulation built upon the RoboTwin-OD object library, which contains 731 731 annotated objects spanning 147 147 categories, together with a large-scale corpus of more than 100 ​ k 100\text{k} expert dual-arm trajectories. The benchmark includes 50 50 collaborative bimanual tasks instantiated across five robot embodiments. Under the standard simulation protocol, each task is trained independently on the Aloha–AgileX dual-arm platform using 50 50 clean expert demonstrations, and evaluated with 100 100 rollouts under two difficulty settings: an Easy setting with uncluttered scenes, and a Hard setting with substantial domain randomization, including clutter, background textures, lighting variations, and tabletop-height perturbations.

blocks.en: In the transfer setting of Sec. 4.3 , the RoboTwin and real-world data use a common observation format and action-space representation. The target domain differs in backgrounds, lighting, object appearance, camera viewpoints, and spatial layouts. For example, the real-world Block Stacking task shares manipulation patterns with RoboTwin’s Stack Blocks Two , despite different visual conditions. During Stage B, A mem A_{\mathrm{mem}} maps target-domain queries into the source memory coordinates, as defined in Eq. ( 7 ), so that relevant source skills can be retrieved and refined through prototype residual updates.
blocks.zh: 在Sec.4.3的传输设置中,RoboTwin和现实世界的数据使用通用的观测格式和动作空间表示. 目标域在背景,照明,物体外观,相机视角,空间布局等方面都有所不同. 例如,现实世界的Block Stacking任务与RoboTwin的Stack Blocks Two共享操纵模式,尽管视觉条件不同. 在B阶段期间,Amem AQQ_{\mathrm{memm}}将目标域查询映射到Eq.(7)定义的源内存坐标中,以便通过原型剩余更新检索和完善相关的源技能.

blocks.en: To rigorously evaluate the lifelong learning capability and the anti-forgetting mechanisms of Optimus-R, we designed a comprehensive suite of real-world robotic manipulation tasks. The evaluation protocol is specifically structured to simulate a challenging continuous learning scenario, encompassing a transition from basic single-arm manipulations to complex, long-horizon bimanual coordination.
blocks.zh: 为了严格评价Optimus-R的终身学习能力和反遗忘机制,我们设计了一套完整的现实世界机器人操纵任务. 评价协议的结构是专门用来模拟一种具有挑战性的连续学习情景,包括从基本的单臂操纵过渡到复杂的、长视距的双人协调。

blocks.en: As summarized in Table 8 , the tasks are strategically divided into two distinct categories: • Category A (Base Tasks): This set comprises 4 fundamental single-arm manipulation tasks(Figs. 7 ), including spatial reorientation and precision placement (e.g., block stacking, placing objects onto specific receptacles). The model is initially trained on this task suite, which provides a total of 570 demonstrations. These tasks serve as the foundation for evaluating the model’s stability (i.e., retention of historical skills) during subsequent lifelong adaptation. • Category B (Novel Tasks): After acquiring the base skills, the model is incrementally adapted to a stream of 5 novel tasks(Figs. 8 ). Crucially, these tasks introduce a significant shift in the control distribution by requiring bimanual coordination and long-horizon sequential logic (e.g., sequential pick-and-place, multi-object collection). This category contains 420 demonstrations in total.
blocks.zh: 如表8所示,这些任务在战略上分为两类:A类(基准任务): 这一组包括4项基本的单臂操纵任务(图7),包括空间方向调整和精确定位(如块堆放、将物体放在特定贮器上)。 该模型最初接受关于这个任务套件的培训,共提供570个演示. 这些任务是评价模型在其后终身适应期间的稳定性(即保留历史技能)的基础。 • B类(小任务): 获得基础技能后,该模型逐渐适应5个新任务(图)的流派. 关键是,这些任务通过要求双向协调和长距离顺序逻辑(如顺序采样和位置,多对象收集),对控制分布带来了显著的转变. 这一类共有420次示威。

blocks.en: This Category A → \rightarrow B transition is intentionally demanding. The shift from single-arm to bimanual control, coupled with the introduction of multi-stage semantic reasoning, typically exacerbates catastrophic forgetting in parameter-centric fine-tuning methods. Evaluating Optimus-R under this protocol effectively demonstrates the robustness of our discrete Query-Skill Memory Bank in preserving old capabilities while assimilating highly distinct new skills.

blocks.en: Appendix G Additional Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录G 补充实验

blocks.en: G.1 Memory-Bank Component Ablations
blocks.zh: G.1 内存银行组件

blocks.en: We evaluate memory-bank design choices on LIBERO using 100% of the training demonstrations and report the average success rate across the four suites. Table 9 compares the full model with variants that omit skill-aware clustering, omit exemplar storage for replay, or replace motion-aware downsampling with uniform downsampling.
blocks.zh: 我们利用100%的培训演示来评价LIBERO的内存库设计选择,并报告四个套房的平均成功率。 表9将完整模型与省略技能意识集群的变体进行比较,省略实例存储进行重播,或用统一的下采样取代运动意识下采样.

blocks.en: Table 9: Memory-bank component ablations on LIBERO with 100% training data.
blocks.zh: 表9:装有100%培训数据的LIBERO存储库组件。

blocks.en: Removing clustering or exemplar storage reduces success by 2.0 and 1.5 percentage points, respectively, supporting their contribution to memory-based adaptation. Uniform downsampling produces a smaller decrease of 0.6 percentage points, suggesting that motion-aware sampling is beneficial but less influential among the tested variants.
blocks.zh: 删除集群或实例存储会分别降低2.0和1.5个百分点的成功率,支持其对基于内存的适应的贡献. 统一下采样产生的下降幅度较小,为0.6个百分点,这表明运动意识取样在经过试验的变种中是有益的,但影响较小。

blocks.en: G.2 Memory-Bank Configuration Sensitivity
blocks.zh: G.2 内存库配置敏感性

blocks.en: We examine the initial bank size K 0 K_{0} , retrieval count K r K_{r} , and number of memory tokens m m on LIBERO at 100% training data. Table 10 distinguishes changes to a single parameter from configurations that jointly change K r K_{r} and m m relative to the default ( 128 , 2 , 4 ) (128,2,4) .
blocks.zh: 我们检查了K 0 K_{0} 检索 K r K_{r} 和LIBERO上 100%的训练数据 的内存符号数 m 。 表10将单个参数的改变与组合区分开来,这些组合与默认值(128,2,4)(128,2,4)相比,共同改变K r K_{r}和 m m.

blocks.en: Table 10: LIBERO configuration sensitivity. Bold entries identify the default configuration. The last two rows jointly vary retrieval count and memory-token count.
blocks.zh: 表10:LIBERO配置敏感性. 粗体条目识别默认配置 。 后两行共同更改检索计数和内存键计数.

blocks.en: Success rates range from 96.8% to 97.8% across the tested configurations. Increasing K 0 K_{0} from 128 to 256 yields no further gain, while reducing K r K_{r} from two to one lowers success to 97.0%. The default therefore attains the highest observed success with fewer prototypes than the 256-entry bank. The joint configurations do not isolate the individual effects of K r K_{r} and m m relative to the default.
blocks.zh: 成功率从96.8%到97.8%不等。 将K 0 K_{0}从128提高至256,没有进一步的收益,同时将K r K_{r}从2降至1,成功率降至97.0%. 因此,与256个进入银行相比,违约取得了最高的成功。 联合配置不孤立 Kr K_{r} 和 m m 相对于默认的单个效果.

blocks.en: G.3 Memory Growth across Task Suites
blocks.zh: G.3 任务组合的记忆增长

blocks.en: To examine memory growth over a longer adaptation sequence, we initialize Optimus-R on LIBERO-90 and then adapt sequentially to Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long. Table 11 reports the occupied prototype count K K , the increment at each stage, retrieval latency, and Recall@5. This sequence starts with 81 occupied prototypes; the counts describe the evolving bank in this experiment rather than the default K 0 = 128 K_{0}=128 configuration above.
blocks.zh: 为了在更长的适应序列中检查内存的成长,我们在LIBERO-90上初始化了Optimus-R,然后依次适应空间,对象,目标,和长. 表11报告占用的原型计数KK、每个阶段的增量、检索延迟和召回@5。 这个序列从81个占用的原型开始;计数描述的是这个实验中不断发展的银行,而不是上面的默认K 0 = 128 K_{0}=128配置.

blocks.en: Table 11: Memory growth during sequential suite adaptation. Prototype increments are relative to the preceding stage; latency measures retrieval rather than full policy inference.
blocks.zh: 表11 相继套装改造过程中的内存增长. 原型增量与前一个阶段相对;暂时性测量检索而不是完全的政策推论.

blocks.en: The bank adds 28 prototypes across four suites, while retrieval latency increases by 0.10 ms and Recall@5 changes from 95.6% to 94.7%. These measurements indicate a modest retrieval overhead over the evaluated sequence. They characterize expansion at this scale, without establishing an upper bound on memory growth or prototype interference.
blocks.zh: 银行在4套套房中增加了28个原型,而检索延迟增加0.10 ms,Recall@5从95.6%改为94.7%. 这些测量表明,在评估的序列上回收费较少。 它们以这个规模来描述扩张的特点,没有在内存生长或原型干扰上建立上限.

blocks.en: G.4 Cross-Suite Transfer from Spatial to Goal
blocks.zh: G.4 从空间到目标的跨套间转让

blocks.en: Starting from the π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} -base checkpoint, we train Optimus-R on the ten LIBERO-Spatial tasks with K 0 = 16 K_{0}=16 , evaluate it zero-shot on LIBERO-Goal, and then adapt it to Goal. The suites differ in scene layouts and initial-state distributions while sharing manipulation patterns, such as placing a bowl on a plate. Table 12 reports overall Goal performance, performance on this shared manipulation pattern, and bank size.
blocks.zh: 从0.5\pi_{0.5}-base检查站开始,我们训练Optimus-R执行十项LIBERO-Spaceal任务,使用K0=16K_{0}=16,在LIBERO-Goal上评价其0射,然后根据Goal调整. 套房在场景布局和初始状态分布上各有不同,同时分享操纵模式,例如将碗放在盘子上. 表12 总计 目标表现,这种共享操纵模式的表现,以及银行规模.

blocks.en: Table 12: Spatial-to-Goal transfer. Bowl-on-plate denotes the Goal task put the bowl on the plate .
blocks.zh: 表12:空间对目标的转移。 Bowl -on -plate表示球员将碗放在盘子上。

blocks.en: The bowl-on-plate task achieves 68% success before target-suite adaptation, consistent with transfer of a manipulation pattern represented in Spatial. However, overall zero-shot success is only 8%, and turn on the stove provides a failure case involving an operation absent from the Spatial tasks. After adaptation, overall success reaches 96% and the bank grows by 11 prototypes. The results support selective transfer of shared behaviors while showing the need for target-task adaptation.
blocks.zh: 碗贴式任务在目标组合调整前取得了68%的成功,这与空间代表的操纵模式的转移是一致的。 然而,总体的零射成功率只有8%,打开炉灶则提供了一个故障案例,涉及空间任务中缺失的操作. 改造后,整体成功率达到96%,银行以11个原型增长. 结果支持选择性地转移共享行为,同时显示需要调整目标任务.

blocks.en: G.5 Task-Wise Continual Learning on LIBERO-Spatial
blocks.zh: G.5 关于LIBERO-空间的连续学习任务

blocks.en: We further evaluate a ten-task sequence on LIBERO-Spatial using the task order of Liu et al. (2026) . Optimus-R starts from π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} -base and trains for 10,000 steps per task, carrying the preceding checkpoint forward. After each stage, we evaluate all tasks observed so far. Adaptation uses the latent exemplar replay described in Sec. D . Table 13 reports the resulting success-rate matrix.
blocks.zh: 我们利用刘等人(2026年)的任务顺序,进一步评估LIBERO-Spacial上的十项任务序列。 Optimus-R从 π 0.5\pi_{0.5} - 基地和火车,每任务1万步,将前一个检查站推进. 在每一个阶段之后,我们评价迄今所观察到的所有任务。 适应使用Sec.D.所述的潜在实例重播。 表13报告了由此产生的成功率矩阵。

blocks.en: Table 13: Task-wise continual learning on LIBERO-Spatial. Entries are success rates (%); dashes denote tasks not yet introduced. T 1 T_{1} – T 10 T_{10} follow the sequence in Liu et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 表13:根据任务继续学习LIBERO-空间技术。 条目是成功率(%);破折表示尚未引入的任务。 T 1 T_{1} – T 10 T_{10} 跟随刘等人的序列 (2026).

blocks.en: We also report negative backward transfer (NBT): for each task, we average its success-rate decrease from its post-training checkpoint over subsequent stages, then average over all ten tasks, assigning zero to the final task. Using success rates on a [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] scale, the sequence yields NBT = 0.009 =0.009 and a final average success rate of 97.6%. This indicates limited average forgetting over the sequence, although retention varies by task; for example, T 5 T_{5} decreases from 98% immediately after training to 90% at the final stage.
blocks.zh: 我们还报告负向后转移(NBT):对于每一项任务,我们平均从培训后检查站到随后各阶段的成功率下降,然后在所有10项任务中平均下降,最后任务为零。 使用[0, 1] [0, 1] 尺度上的成功率,测序值为NBT = 0.009 = 0.009,最终平均成功率为97.6%. 这表明对序列的遗忘率有限,尽管保留率因任务而异;例如,T 5 T_{5)在培训后立即从98%降至最后阶段的90%。
